# Eligible evidence and stdout result.
exitcode 0 --suite suite.json --baseline baseline.json --candidate candidate.json --improver worker
stdout '"eligible": true'

# Valid evidence with a critical veto.
exitcode 1 --suite suite.json --baseline baseline.json --candidate veto.json --improver worker
stdout 'critical_case_failed'

# Invalid invocation, malformed traces, and unavailable output destination.
exitcode 2
stderr 'required:'
exitcode 2 --unknown
exitcode 2 --suite suite.json --baseline baseline.json --candidate malformed.json --improver worker
stderr 'candidate:'
exitcode 2 --suite suite.json --baseline baseline.json --candidate candidate.json --improver worker --out missing/result.json
stderr 'missing'
